title: Lamb Ssam with Mediterranean Flair
description: A twist on traditional Korean ssam, this recipe combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the tender taste of lamb.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: Boneless and tied with kitchen twine

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, oregano, lemon juice, and 1 clove minced garlic.
3. Place lamb shoulder in a large zip-top plastic bag and pour marinade over it.
4. Seal bag and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Remove lamb from marinade and grill for 4-5 minutes per side or until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
6. Let lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
7. Warm ssam wraps by wrapping them in foil and heating them on the grill for 2-3 minutes.
8. Assemble ssam by placing a few slices of lamb onto each wrap, followed by pickled daikon, and any other desired toppings.
